posts.trend: India VIX Ends Flat at 17.68 as Sensex Rallies 1,500 Points
posts.context: Every friend group has someone who panics on a red day, pauses their SIP, and watches the market jump 1,500 points the very next morning.
posts.angle: Long-term investing discipline lasts right up until one red candle, and resumes right at the market peak.

landing_options.line: Usne crash pe becha. Ab rally pe wapas khareedega.

Ab woh phir shuru karega. Bilkul top pe.
1,500 point baad sab phir se finance expert hain.

slides: Kal raat jis dost ne SIP band kiya tha, aaj Sensex 1,500 point upar hai.

"Haan bhai, dekh liya TV pe."
"Nahi, main toh waise bhi safety ke liye FD kar raha tha."
"Haan, aaj hi app khol ke unpause karne wala hoon."

posts.caption: Send this to the friend who pauses their SIP on every red day and unpauses at the peak 📉
